points.t: Non-blanching red or purple spots or bruises, in a child or an adult.
Low or faulty platelets, clotting problems, fragile vessels (age, steroids, scurvy) or vessel inflammation.
Glass test; is the patient unwell? FBC and film, clotting, U&E, LFT, CRP, urine; same-day if unwell or platelets low.
Meningococcal sepsis, leukaemia, ITP, DIC, cryoglobulinaemic or ANCA vasculitis, non-accidental injury.

items.t: Unwell with a non-blanching rash: **999**, benzylpenicillin if there will be a delay (NICE NG240).
Petechiae with pallor, lymph nodes, bone pain or bruising: **same-day FBC and film** (leukaemia, ITP).

pearls.t: Teach parents the **glass/tumbler test**, but stress that an **unwell child needs urgent help even if the rash blanches**.
